children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, climb as inflation worries resurface due to rising oil prices. Brent crude rises 0.3% to $96 a barrel following reports about Iranian attacks on a U.S. base in Bahrain over the weekend. High energy prices are driving concerns about inflation and the risk of rapid interest-rate rises by the Bank of England over the coming months. Ten-year gilt yields climb 1.1 basis point to last trade at 5.345%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
